name: cascade
description: Adaptive model, reasoning, context, verification, and parallel-work orchestration for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Routes each coding step to the least-expensive capable model or deterministic tool, minimizes context transfer, isolates concurrent writes, verifies outcomes, and learns only from admitted evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Cascade to plan and route this coding task.
Run this task with minimum safe model usage.
